text:
Margo: Heads-up — Oxley onboarding health check finished. We see steady throughput but occasional tail spikes on PDF->summarize flows. Token costs creeping up. Thinking proactive: propose int8 quant on their current model and route 20% of traffic to a compact variant for non-critical prompts. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

James: Strong +1 for mixed-model routing. Suggest prefix-based rule: long document summaries to heavy model, short FAQs to compact. Cuts both token and compute cost. Can we get a representative sample from Oxley to validate?

Margo: Asked Oxley PM to drop ~100 sample requests into the shared S3 bucket (link posted privately). They're uploading now.

Rohit: Before enabling quant, we need a small quality gate: run 1k prompt pairs (base vs int8) and measure semantic drift + hallucination. If semantic delta < 1.5% and hallucination unchanged, greenlight. I can run on a tiny fleet ~3h.

Olivia: When we route ~20% to compact, add deterministic fallback to heavy model on low-confidence or error. Also pipe per-route logs to Console so CS sees quality signals in near-real time.

James: Draft routing rule (canary):
```
route_rules:
  - name: short-faqs
    match: "len(prompt_tokens) < 120 and intent == 'faq'"
    model: oxley-compact-v1
    traffic: 20%
  - fallback: oxley-base-v2
```
We’ll run this in a Dedicated canary for 24h.

Margo: Timeline: Rohit runs evals today, James configures canary tomorrow AM, I’ll own customer comms and the short enablement doc.

Rohit: Started evals at 13:12 UTC. Quick log:
```
[eval-run] 100/1000 done. avg latency quant=12ms, base=14ms. preliminary perf delta: -0.9% on latency.
```
Promising so far.

James: I’ll provision the compact variant in a canary pool and wire a tracing hook to Console (per-route token breakdown + per-response confidence). Ping me if you want on-call during rollout.

Olivia: Please add regression alerts: quality delta > 2% and p99 latency > 500ms. Also add a dashboard row for renewal-risk signals (sustained cost upticks or repeated quality alerts).

Margo: Note on renewal risk — Oxley mentioned cost as a renewal concern. This proactive play (quant + hybrid routing + caching) should materially reduce unit cost. I’ll prepare a short deck showing estimated cost reduction and reliability guarantees.

James: Ops note: enable prefix/KV caching for their summarize flow — a lot of prompts share the same document headers. Cache + compact routing should shave ~15% tokens.

Rohit: Eval finished. Summary:
- semantic delta: 0.8%
- hallucination rate: no change
- p95 latency: quant down 12% vs base
Marking green for canary. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/oxley/6123456799/results.json

Margo: Thanks. I'll message Oxley PM: schedule canary tomorrow 09:00 PST for 24h, expand to 50% if stable. Also request customer sign-off for the A/B.

James: Command I’ll run to apply canary stack:
```
redwood route apply --stack oxley-canary --rules ./oxley-routes.yaml
```

Olivia: Filed Product ticket RD-2241 to surface per-account suggested optimizations in Console so CS can present these plays proactively.

Margo: Action items recap: Rohit -> attach eval artifact + confirm no quality regressions; James -> canary rule + cache enable; Olivia -> dashboard & alerts; Margo -> customer comms + renewal deck. I’ll post a short recap to Oxley after James confirms canary deployed. :thumbsup:
